content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) emphasizes that insulin dosing for patients receiving enteral or parenteral nutrition should be tailored to the individual needs of the patient. A general recommendation is to administer 1 unit of insulin for every 10 to 15 grams of carbohydrates provided through enteral or parenteral feeding. It is essential to maintain consistent insulin dosing as part of nutritional management, with adjustments made based on the specific nutritional composition of the formula being used. This approach is critical to achieving and maintaining proper glycemic control.
